senses.gloss: उत्तितीर्षु उत्तितीर्षु, i. e. उद्-तितीर्ष, desider. of तॄ, + उ, adj. Desirous to step out, MBh. 11, 160.

ऊति ऊति, f. i. e.
 I. अव् + ति,
 1. Assistance, Chr. 288, 14 = Rigv. i. 48, 14; help, Lass. 98, 16 = Rigv. v. 9, 6; ऊती, ved. instr. sing, Chr. 291, 13 = Rigv. i. 64, 13.
 2. Quickness, Bhāg. P. 8, 5, 44.
 II. वे + ति, Web, tissue, Bhāg. P. 2, 10, 1; 4.
